---
name: Publish org-standards package to agent-toolkit

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - "docs/apm/org-standards/**"
      - ".github/workflows/publish-asr-to-agent-toolkit.md"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  copilot-requests: write

network: defaults

safe-outputs:
  create-pull-request:
    target-repo: "kronostechnologies/agent-toolkit"
    base-branch: "main"
    title-prefix: "QCTECH-5463 "
    labels: [automation, apm]

---

You are publishing the generated `org-standards` APM package source into the `agent-toolkit`
mono-repo, where it is consumed via APM (`kronostechnologies/agent-toolkit/plugins/org-standards`).

## Instructions

1. Read the full tree at `docs/apm/org-standards/.apm/` from this repository
   (`kronostechnologies/standards`, `master` branch) — this is the freshly generated source of
   truth, already complete with frontmatter for every file.
2. In the target repository (`kronostechnologies/agent-toolkit`), read the current
   `plugins/org-standards/.apm/` tree and `plugins/org-standards/apm.yml`.
3. Mirror the source tree into `plugins/org-standards/.apm/` **verbatim**, including frontmatter —
   do not regenerate, reformat, or otherwise transform file content:
   - **Add** any file present in the source but missing in the target.
   - **Update** any file whose content differs.
   - **Delete** any file present in the target but no longer present in the source — in
     particular, if `instructions/asr.instructions.md` no longer exists in the source (it has been
     replaced by the new scoped-file structure), delete it from
     `plugins/org-standards/.apm/instructions/asr.instructions.md`. This is a redistribution of the
     same rules across new files, not a removal of content, so it is **not** a breaking change for
     consumers — the next `apm install` picks up the new files automatically.
4. If any file was added, updated, or deleted, bump the `version` field in
   `plugins/org-standards/apm.yml` following SemVer:
   - Deleting `asr.instructions.md` in favor of the new scoped files (a one-time structural
     migration) is **MINOR**, not MAJOR — no rule content is lost, only redistributed.
   - Otherwise: PATCH for wording/formatting-only changes, MINOR for added/removed rules, MAJOR
     only if a rule is fully reversed (rare).
   If nothing changed, make no edits and do not open a pull request.
5. Open a pull request in `kronostechnologies/agent-toolkit` with these file changes, titled
   `sync: update org-standards from kronostechnologies/standards@<short-sha>` and a description
   that links back to the commit in `kronostechnologies/standards` that triggered this run, and
   that explicitly lists which files were added/updated/deleted.

Do not modify anything else in `agent-toolkit` — not other packages, not the root `apm.yml`, not
`apm.lock.yaml`, not `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (that file is machine-generated by
`apm pack`, never hand-edited).
